name: web-macro
description: Production-focused multi-tab browser macro controller with workflow orchestration and JSON config portability.

scripts.check: node --check lib/browser-input.js && node --check lib/runtime-publisher.js && node --check lib/config-catalog.js && node --check lib/host-scheduler.js && node --check lib/power-saving.js && node --check lib/sequence.js && node --check scripts/performance-benchmark.js && node --check server.js && node --check browser-discovery.js && node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('public/app.js','utf8'))" && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
scripts.postinstall: playwright install chromium && npm run build:css
